params.name: include
params.description:
Comma-separated extra data:
- `stats`: a `stats` object per artist — `followers`, `monthly_listeners`, `world_rank`,
  `top_cities` (city, country, region, listeners) — and `followers.total` filled when null
  (about +0.5-1 s for 50 artists, cached 1 h).
- `insights`: an `insights` object per artist — `genres`, `moods`, `activities` (mean
  weight over the top tracks and how many carry each), `bpm`, `country`, `top_track_ids`
  (same data as `/artist_insights`; about +0.3 s).
`include_status` reports `{requested, resolved}` per option; unknown values are null.
